display.purpose: Selected report title and page title only.

body.purpose: Long-form Markdown report content with generous line height.

label.purpose: Dense metadata, filters, market codes, and compact control labels.

rules: Use motion only for state change, focus, reveal, and report switching.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion with instant transitions or crossfades.
Do not choreograph a decorative page-load sequence.

layout.desktop: Sticky top toolbar, left report rail, main reading workspace.
layout.mobile: Toolbar, filter chips, report list, selected report summary, then Markdown body.

valuationStrip.purpose: Compare safety value, current value, and intrinsic value.
valuationStrip.accessibility: Always include text labels and numeric values; never encode risk only by color.

reportListItem.purpose: Select reports quickly while showing market, date, score, and model action.

dos: Keep the interface white, precise, and readable.
Use cobalt and violet as functional marks only.
Prefer borders, spacing, and typography over shadows.
Keep long-form report reading as the main event.
donts: Do not create a dark neon trading terminal.
Do not create a generic SaaS card wall.
Do not use decorative charts, glassmorphism, gradient text, or thick colored side stripes.
Do not rely on color alone for state.
